meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: "As of July 1995, Minnesota State Law (§122A.41) on Peer Review requires all Minnesota school districts to develop and use a peer review process. During the first three years, teachers new to the District will participate in the Achievement of Tenure Process. Tenured teachers follow the Professional Development Process as outlined in this section."
